meta.name: agent-browser
meta.description: Automates browser interactions for web testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction. Use when the user needs to navigate websites, interact with web pages, fill forms, take screenshots, test web applications, or extract information from web pages.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动操作浏览器完成测试、填表、截图和数据提取
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要自动化浏览器操作来完成测试或数据采集
copy.tagline_en: Automate browser interactions for testing, form filling, screenshots, and data extraction
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate browser tasks like testing, form filling, or data extraction

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以自动控制浏览器：打开网页、点击链接、填写表单、截图、提取页面文字等。
howto.when: 当你需要浏览网站、填写表单、提取数据、截取屏幕或测试 Web 应用时触发。

say.note: Claude 会启动浏览器访问百度并保存截图。

say.text: 帮我填写这个登录表单
say.note: Claude 会定位输入框并填入信息。

say.text: 提取当前页面的所有链接
say.note: Claude 会分析页面并返回链接列表。

howto.what_en: Automates browser interactions: open URLs, click elements, fill forms, take screenshots, extract text, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to navigate websites, fill forms, extract data, take screenshots, or test web applications.

say_en.text: Open Baidu homepage and take a screenshot
say_en.note: Claude will launch browser and save screenshot.

say_en.text: Help me fill in this login form
say_en.note: Claude will locate inputs and fill them.

say_en.text: Extract all links from the current page
say_en.note: Claude will analyze page and return links.
